title: Penny Item Found & Best Penny Deal Scanner App
body: This app is awesome. By far the best one I've tried. I have tried a few of the penny deal scanners & 99% of them are filled with inaccurate junk and unrelated spam. This is the first one I've found that is accurate and updated. I mainly use it just for the clearance deals that I use for reselling. It lets you click any of them, and it will even take you directly to Home Depot's own website to verify the pricing is accurate before driving to the store. I even tried to get a penny item / penny deal and (while I know they're not guaranteed) I EVEN SCORED A PENNY ITEM!! Great experience so far.
